content.text:
Commands now take the height they need, and that drives the body's height. All 223 tests pass (1 ignored), both builds have no warnings, and the piton checks and build pass.

**What was wrong:** after the last change the body shrank to fit, but a full button still stretched to fill its group, so its icon and label sat in whatever space the tallest column left. The button component also pins a 32px height, which that stretching had been hiding.

**Now** (`src/ribbon/mod.rs`, `src/ribbon/application_tab.rs`):
- **A full button is as tall as its icon and label need** — 52px — and no taller.
- **Commands sit at the top of their group** instead of stretching to it.
- **The body is the tallest column plus 8px above and below.** Since a column holds at most three slim buttons, the tallest the body gets is 98px.

**Heights per tab:** Project 68px (two slim stacked), Application 68px (one full button), Spec 98px (three slim stacked), Code and Research 38px ("No commands yet"). On Spec, the full buttons are 52px and start at the same line as the slim columns beside them rather than stretching to 82px.

**Tests:**
- The main window test now also checks that on Spec a full button stays shorter than the buttons' room in its group and starts at the top. Putting the stretching back fails it.
- The group layout test checks a full command keeps its own height beside a three-button column.

**Spec:** a full button is "as tall as its large icon above its label need, and no taller"; commands take the height they need from the top of their group; the height section says the commands drive the height, capped at three slim buttons stacked, 98px. The dark-mode switch block is described as a button's colour, a button's width, and as tall as its switch and label need, since it no longer stretches either.

I haven't looked at this in the running app; heights here come from the test layout.
